如果您想了解 Krea2 双阶段渲染工作流程在实践中的工作原理，请先观看完整视频。该视频演示了一个两阶段的 Krea2 生产链，该生产链使用 RAW 模型来构建初始图像，并使用 Turbo 模型来细化和完成最终结果。

此 ComfyUI 工作流程专为 Krea2 RAW 绘图和 Turbo 精加工而设计。与简单的一次性 Krea2 工作流程不同，此版本将渲染分为两个阶段。第一阶段侧重于结构、构图和早期视觉形成。第二阶段使用 Turbo 模型来收紧图像、改善最终外观并创建更精美的输出。

第一阶段加载 krea2_raw_fp8_scaled.safetensors 作为 RAW 基础模型。该 RAW 路线通过 rg Three 的 Power Lora Loader 传递，并以强度 0.7 启用多个 LoRA 文件。活动 LoRA 堆栈包括 QJ_Krea2_Lora_E15_mk2、Detailer-KREA2、Neo_Rococo_Krea2_v1、dora、krea2_neondrip、krea2-mikkoph 和 krea2_Enhancer。这为 RAW 阶段在图像传递到第二阶段之前提供了强大的风格化基础。

第二阶段加载 krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors 作为 Turbo 精加工模型。它还使用具有相同风格增强逻辑的 Power Lora Loader 堆栈。这使得最终通道能够保持 RAW 阶段的视觉方向，同时添加更干净、更精致的 Krea2 Turbo 表面。

文本编码器路线使用带有 Krea2 CLIP 类型的 qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors。 VAE路线使用qwen_image_vae.safetensors进行解码。分辨率路线使用具有 1.5 兆像素目标、9:21 超高纵横比和可被 64 整除的对齐方式的 FluxResolutionNode。这使得该工作流程适用于高大的垂直海报、手机壁纸、超现实时尚肖像、奇幻封面和社交媒体视觉资产。

第 1 阶段采样器使用具有 30 个步骤的 KSampler、CFG 4、欧拉采样器、简单调度程序、随机种子和降噪 1。此阶段创建完整的初始 RAW 图像基础。然后，第 2 阶段采样器将第 1 阶段潜在样本作为其输入，并使用 CFG 1、欧拉采样器、简单调度器、固定种子 666 和降噪 0.42 运行另外 30 个步骤。第二遍旨在保留第一阶段的构图，同时通过 Turbo 模型细化最终图像。

该工作流程还包括第一阶段结果的中间解码和保存路径，因此可以在最终 Turbo 细化之前检查 RAW 阶段输出。这对于比较第二阶段对图像的改变程度以及 Turbo 精加工通道是否改善了纹理、照明和最终视觉效果非常有用。

示例提示重点关注一幅超现实的时尚肖像：一个苍白空灵的人物侧面，穿着一件雕塑般的黑色高领外套，在柔和的灰绿色背景下。巨大的半透明粉色金鱼漂浮在头部周围，而由苍白的手状形状制成的生物力学有机头饰覆盖了上脸。该场景被设计为奢华概念社论与神奇超现实插画的结合，优雅的负空间、诗意的人体恐怖装饰、精致的质感和梦幻般的未来风格。

主要特点：

  • Krea2 双阶段渲染工作流程

  • RAW阶段图像基础

  • 涡轮级最终精炼

  • krea2_raw_fp8_scaled.safetensors RAW模型

  • krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors Turbo 模型

  • rgtri 为 Lora Loader 提供动力

  • 多个 LoRA 堆栈支持

  • LoRA强度0.7风格增强

  • qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors 文本编码器

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors VAE

  • 第 1 阶段：30 个步骤，CFG 4，降噪 1

  • 第 2 阶段：30 个步骤，CFG 1，降噪 0.42

  • 欧拉采样器

  • 简单的调度程序

  • RAW 到 Turbo 潜在切换

  • 中级 1 预览并保存路线

  • 1.5兆像素分辨率路线

  • 9:21 超高垂直格式

  • 最终 VAEDecode、PreviewImage 和 SaveImage 输出

  • 适用于超现实肖像、时尚社论、奇幻海报和 Krea2 模型切换测试

建议的工作流程：

当单个 Krea2 渲染感觉过于原始或过于锁定于一种模型行为时，请使用此工作流程。让 RAW 阶段构建初始图像结构，然后让 Turbo 阶段细化结果。从具有强烈的构图、清晰的主题身份、受控的调色板和定义的最终风格的提示开始。由于 LoRA 堆栈已经很强大，因此请避免添加太多不相关的样式关键字。使用中间预览来判断RAW阶段是否已经很强。如果 Turbo 级变化太大，请降低第二级噪声。如果最终结果还是感觉未完成，请在更改模型之前在提示中强化主题、灯光和材质细节 链。

o.en:
Watch the full video first if you want to understand how this Krea2 dual-phase rendering workflow works in practice. The video demonstrates a two-stage Krea2 production chain that uses a RAW model to build the initial image and a Turbo model to refine and complete the final result.

This ComfyUI workflow is designed for Krea2 RAW drafting and Turbo finishing. Unlike a simple one-pass Krea2 workflow, this version separates the render into two phases. The first phase focuses on structure, composition, and early visual formation. The second phase uses a Turbo model to tighten the image, improve the final look, and create a more polished output.

The first stage loads krea2_raw_fp8_scaled.safetensors as the RAW base model. This RAW route is passed through Power Lora Loader from rgthree, with multiple LoRA files enabled at strength 0.7. The active LoRA stack includes QJ_Krea2_Lora_E15_mk2, Detailer-KREA2, Neo_Rococo_Krea2_v1, dora, krea2_neondrip, krea2-mikkoph, and krea2_Enhancer. This gives the RAW stage a strong stylized foundation before the image is handed to the second phase.

The second stage loads krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors as the Turbo finishing model. It also uses a Power Lora Loader stack with the same style-enhancement logic. This allows the final pass to keep the visual direction of the RAW stage while adding a cleaner and more finished Krea2 Turbo surface.

The text encoder route uses qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors with the Krea2 CLIP type. The VAE route uses qwen_image_vae.safetensors for decoding. The resolution route uses FluxResolutionNode with a 1.5 megapixel target, 9:21 Ultra Tall aspect ratio, and divisible-by-64 alignment. This makes the workflow suitable for tall vertical posters, mobile wallpapers, surreal fashion portraits, fantasy covers, and social-media visual assets.

The Stage 1 sampler uses KSampler with 30 steps, CFG 4, euler sampler, simple scheduler, random seed, and denoise 1. This stage creates the full initial RAW image foundation. The Stage 2 sampler then takes the Stage 1 latent as its input and runs another 30 steps with CFG 1, euler sampler, simple scheduler, fixed seed 666, and denoise 0.42. This second pass is designed to preserve the first-stage composition while refining the final image through the Turbo model.

The workflow also includes an intermediate decode and save path for the first-stage result, so the RAW-stage output can be inspected before the final Turbo refinement. This is useful for comparing how much the second phase changes the image and whether the Turbo finishing pass improves texture, lighting, and final visual impact.

The example prompt focuses on a surreal fashion portrait: a pale ethereal figure in profile, wearing a sculptural black turtleneck coat against a soft gray-green background. Large translucent pink goldfish float around the head, while a biomechanical-organic headdress made from pale hand-like forms covers the upper face. The scene is designed as a luxury conceptual editorial mixed with magical surreal illustration, with elegant negative space, poetic body-horror ornamentation, refined texture, and dreamlike futuristic style.

Main features:

  • Krea2 dual-phase rendering workflow

  • RAW-stage image foundation

  • Turbo-stage final refinement

  • krea2_raw_fp8_scaled.safetensors RAW model

  • krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors Turbo model

  • Power Lora Loader by rgthree

  • Multiple LoRA stack support

  • LoRA strength 0.7 style enhancement

  • qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors text encoder

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors VAE

  • Stage 1: 30 steps, CFG 4, denoise 1

  • Stage 2: 30 steps, CFG 1, denoise 0.42

  • euler sampler

  • simple scheduler

  • RAW-to-Turbo latent handoff

  • Intermediate Stage 1 preview and save route

  • 1.5 megapixel resolution route

  • 9:21 Ultra Tall vertical format

  • Final VAEDecode, PreviewImage, and SaveImage output

  • Suitable for surreal portraits, fashion editorials, fantasy posters, and Krea2 model-handoff testing

Suggested workflow:

Use this workflow when a single Krea2 render feels either too raw or too locked into one model behavior. Let the RAW stage build the initial image structure, then let the Turbo stage refine the result. Start with a prompt that has strong composition, clear subject identity, controlled color palette, and a defined final style. Because the LoRA stack is already strong, avoid adding too many unrelated style keywords. Use the intermediate preview to judge whether the RAW stage is already strong. If the Turbo stage changes too much, lower the second-stage denoise. If the final result still feels unfinished, strengthen the subject, lighting, and material details in the prompt before changing the model chain.
